testEffect: The test never calls `applyDiscount`; it creates and asserts against a local mock function (`vi.fn(() => 99)`) that unconditionally returns 99, replacing the owned discount logic under test with a stand-in.
productionEffect: Corrupting `applyDiscount` in any way (for example always throwing, or always returning 0) has no effect on this test, since `applyDiscount` is never invoked; it is expected to keep passing under that production mutation.
